purpose: To score payments in real-time to detect and respond to fraudulent activity.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: The scoring-engine writes a decision to decisions-db (PostgreSQL) and an audit record to the scoring audit log group.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: payment-events (MSK) delivers one event per payment to the scoring-engine.
